reason: Drizzle Kit 0.31.11 still includes the deprecated loader. Its esbuild serve mode is not used by this project; migrations use drizzle-orm, not this loader.
mitigation: Do not expose esbuild serve or Drizzle Studio. Run schema tooling only on trusted sources and disposable/local databases.
removeWhen: Drizzle Kit removes the loader or updates its esbuild chain. Do not force an incompatible pre-1.0 esbuild update under core-utils.
exploitConditions: Requires starting the vulnerable esbuild development HTTP server and visiting an attacker-controlled website that reads its wildcard-CORS responses. This chain is used for schema tooling, not API request handling.

reason: No patched version is published in the advisory. The dependency is a build-time configuration merger, outside the API runtime.
mitigation: Use repository-controlled build configuration; do not merge untrusted request data into build options.
removeWhen: A fixed upstream version or compatible parent replacement becomes available.
exploitConditions: Requires merging attacker-controlled object keys into build configuration; prototype poisoning can alter inherited values.

reason: The reported fix is major 11, incompatible with the callable major-3 API used by this build dependency.
mitigation: Only repository-controlled glob patterns are supplied to the build; do not accept external patterns or run untrusted builds with secrets.
removeWhen: The checker plugin supports a patched minimatch without changing the build architecture.
exploitConditions: Advisory describes attacker-controlled patterns with optimizationLevel >= 2 causing preprocessing amplification and CPU/memory exhaustion. Its range also flags major 3; no compatibility-breaking override is assumed safe.

reason: The reported patch requires minimatch major 11 through an upstream glob upgrade.
mitigation: Build patterns are trusted repository configuration, not remote request input.
removeWhen: Nest CLI supports the patched glob/minimatch chain on the approved Node runtime.
exploitConditions: Advisory describes attacker-controlled patterns with optimizationLevel >= 2 causing preprocessing amplification and CPU/memory exhaustion. Its range also flags major 3; no compatibility-breaking override is assumed safe.

reason: The cancellation fix requires glob major 14. Replacing this internal CLI API is outside a compatible dependency update.
mitigation: Builds traverse a bounded trusted checkout and have a CI job timeout. No runtime route invokes glob.
removeWhen: Nest CLI publishes a compatible dependency update to glob >=14.0.2.
exploitConditions: Requires a costly async directory walk whose caller relies on AbortSignal cancellation; the affected walk continues background I/O after abort.
